meta.name: post-mortem-learning
meta.description: Analyze failures and suboptimal deliveries to identify root causes, contributing factors, and raw lessons. Activate after significant delivery failures, repeated QA failures, or when patterns of issues need to be understood.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析失败原因，提炼经验教训
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队经常遇到交付失败或反复出现质量问题，需要系统化复盘
copy.tagline_en: Analyze failures to extract root causes and lessons
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team faces frequent delivery failures or recurring quality issues and needs systematic reviews

howto.what: 分析失败和欠佳交付，找出根本原因、促成因素和原始教训，输出根因分析报告、失败时间线、规则缺口、教训清单和改进候选。
howto.when: 在重大交付失败、同一区域重复QA失败、交付未达成功指标或需要系统理解问题模式时触发。

say.text: 分析这个功能的QA失败原因。
帮我复盘这个冲刺的交付问题。
say.note: 获取失败时间线和教训

say.text: 从这些失败中提取原始教训。

howto.what_en: Analyzes failures and suboptimal deliveries to identify root causes, contributing factors, and raw lessons. Outputs root cause analysis report, failure timeline, rule gaps, lesson list, and improvement candidates.
howto.when_en: Triggers after significant delivery failures, repeated QA failures on the same area, delivery missing success metrics, or when patterns of issues need systemic understanding.

say_en.text: Analyze the QA failure reasons for this feature.
Help me review the delivery issues in this sprint.
Extract raw lessons from these failures.
